releaseNotes: HWM 0.2.5.12 contains service 0.2.5.10 and tray 1.0.0.8. Tray 1.0.0.8 fixes the remaining first-open USER32 stack overflow by deferring MainForm native handle creation until the window is actually shown, rather than creating the full hidden WinForms handle tree during tray-only startup. Extra UI crash breadcrumbs were added around handle creation and visibility transitions. Existing updater verification, rollback, terminal and Mesh recovery behaviour remain unchanged.
